desc: Build an adjacency list from `edges` containing `(neighbor, edge_length)` pairs.
Implement iterative enter/exit DFS with current depth, cumulative weighted distance, valid-path left boundary depth, prefix distances, and path-local last-seen value depths.
On entering a node, set `new_left = max(parent_left, previous_depth_of_value + 1)` when its value is active; evaluate distance and node-count tie-break.
On exit, restore the value’s previous active depth so sibling subtrees are isolated.
Execute and verify the provided sample cases and targeted edge cases.
